info.name: unisouk-assignment
info.description:
UniSouk OpenCart Backend assignment API collection (C-28).

Prerequisites:
- docker compose up -d (app + worker + opencart + postgres + redis)
- OpenCart API user configured per docs/SETUP.md
- Orders 1, 2, 3 created in OpenCart admin per docs/SETUP.md

Seed IDs: products 28,29,30,42,49 | orders 1,2,3 | variant option_value_id 15 (Red on product 30).

Run E2E Flow folder sequentially via Collection Runner after fresh pending order 1.
